elevation.subseaPolicy: Negative Terrarium values are flattened to the sea/lake surface datum (0 m); this fixture does not encode bathymetry.

limitations: Coarse host terrain and water are not a surveyed river or approach datum.
Photo-proportioned pier heights and end abutments are retained; final native fit requires current render inspection.

terrainReference.basis: South mapped cycleway landing terrain attaches to the authored deck at Y=5.8. The higher bank establishes a stable host-relative bridge level; not surveyed river stage.

finding: The previous sea-level-zero and center-terrain placements were too low at the bank. South mapped deck landing terrain now attaches to model deck Y=5.8. Both corrected bank views show continuous supported joins. River/piers, bank grades and the surrounding generic map context remain approximate; no source DEM or native water geometry is changed.
